[Verse 1]
She wasn’t granite anymore
She walked in
Rose-quartz
Glow under dim house lights
Like a secret
On the tip of your tongue

Pink lace tracing her shoulders
Thin as fault lines
Sweet little fibs
Running through stone
Soft      intricate
A trap you volunteer for

[Chorus]
Beneath that lace
It’s leather
Smooth and dark
Daring you closer
Cool like onyx
’til your hands get brave
She’s marble dusted in honey
Gold on every wave
Sweet enough to pull you under
Thick enough to make you stay

[Verse 2]
She laughs      and the room tilts
Every head
A planet in her orbit
You swear you see
The chisel marks
Where she carved herself from hurt

Cream pooling over those edges
Slow spill
Down a faultless line
You taste her name
Before you say it
Afraid you might
Believe it

Chiseled away at her curves like a sculptor obsessed —
not to reduce her, but to reveal her.

Every edge refined, every dip and swell deliberate.
Stone turned silk beneath invisible hands,
hips shaped like rolling hills carved by patient rivers,
waist drawn in like marble tightened under heat.

She was art in progress —
dust at her feet, fire in her veins.

Not softened.
Defined.

Each line sharpened until light traced her body like a lover’s fingertip.
Each hollow and rise catching shadow, building tension.

She wasn’t erased — she was unveiled.
A masterpiece pulled from stone,
curves cut bold and unapologetic,
standing there like desire given form

[Chorus]
Beneath that lace
It’s leather
Smooth and dark
Daring you closer
Cool like onyx
’til your hands get brave
She’s marble dusted in honey
Gold on every wave
Sweet enough to pull you under
Thick enough to make you stay

I’m learning strength is not pretending
That the battle isn't still beginning.

But I don't have to turn the key,

But I know which way I want to go,

**COFFEEBREAK: SIXTEEN GOING ON SEVENTEEN**

*Original musical-theatre waltz, 3/4, tender and innocent*

**[INTRO | Piano, very soft | p]**

**KAREN:**
Sixteen years and one more birthday,
Standing where the old meets new,
Wondering what tomorrow's hiding,
Wondering what dreams come true.

There are songs I haven't sung yet,
Roads I haven't wandered through,
And a little voice inside me
Says there's something more to do.

**[BRET | Gentle, reassuring | mp]**

**BRET:**
You don't need to chase tomorrow,
Let it find you when it's time,
There's a beauty in discovering
Every little step you climb.

Keep your laughter, keep your wonder,
Keep that sparkle in your eyes,
Growing up is not a doorway
That you have to rush inside.

**[KAREN | Brighter | mf]**

But I want to see the mountains,
I want to dance beneath the moon,
I want to fill my little notebook
With a thousand dreams in bloom.

**[BRET]**

Then take each day as it comes,
Let the morning lead the way,
There's a world of songs awaiting
Every brand-new day.

**[BOTH | Warm duet | mf]**

**CoffeeBreak, CoffeeBreak,**
Pause a while and let us dream,
CoffeeBreak, CoffeeBreak,
Life is brighter than it seems.

Sixteen going on seventeen,
Standing on tomorrow's shore,
There's a whole wide world of wonder
Waiting just beyond the door.

**[INSTRUMENTAL | Strings enter, gentle waltz]**

**KAREN:**
Maybe I'll change,
Maybe I'll grow,
Maybe there's something
I don't yet know.

**BRET:**
That's what makes the journey
Worth taking one day at a time.

**KAREN:**
Then I'll keep singing—

**BRET:**
And I'll keep the rhythm—

**BOTH:**
And we'll let the music climb!

**[FULL DUET | f → ff]**

**CoffeeBreak, CoffeeBreak!**
Let the little moments shine!
CoffeeBreak, CoffeeBreak!
Turn an ordinary day divine!

Sixteen going on seventeen,
With a thousand dreams to chase,
With a song inside my heart
And tomorrow's open space.

**[FINAL BUILD | Full strings + piano]**

**KAREN:**
I may not know where I'm going...

**BRET:**
You don't have to know today.

**KAREN:**
I can hear tomorrow calling—

**BRET:**
Then listen, and find your way.

**BOTH:**
Sixteen going on seventeen,
New beginnings coming through,
Every day another chapter,
Every dream becoming new.

**CoffeeBreak, CoffeeBreak!**
Sing it softly, sing it bright!
CoffeeBreak, CoffeeBreak!
Carry music through the night!

**[FINAL | ritardando | p]**

**KAREN:**
Sixteen...

**BRET:**
Going forward...

**BOTH:**
...with a song to see us through.

**[Piano resolves softly.]**

Pop and glide so sweet as we melt right down

Slide my crunchy slime nice and deep in your cloud  
Feel the glitter glow, mixing candy all around  
Juicy squelch and stretch, butter soft and light  
Like ice cream melting in this gooey, tingly night

Rubbing little circles, popcorn pops ignite  
Galaxy swirling, making everything shine  
Your jelly bouncing, sweet as summer time

Warm and overflowing, like popcorn in the sky

Slide my crunchy slime nice and deep in your cloud  
Feel the glitter glow, mixing candy all around  
Juicy squelch and stretch, butter soft and light  
Drowning slow together in this slippery, endless high  

[Outro]  
Let it all melt… soft sighs in the light  
Bunny sweet and sticky… pure slime delight

"upbeat pop with R&B vibes, slow sensual groove turning fun and bouncy, heavy bass, wet ASMR slime sounds with gentle pops and squelches, breathy female vocals, glossy production, playful candy-pop energy"
